jobs.title: Operations Manager, Therapy Program
jobs.why: Excellent overlap with behavioral health operations, therapy-program scaling, cross-functional coordination, workflow improvement, staff support and healthcare systems work.
jobs.gap: The role may expect deeper formal operations ownership and program-level KPI management than your current title suggests, so your application should emphasize the operational projects you actually own.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Operations
jobs.why: Strong fit for project management, client onboarding, business analysis, process improvement, SOPs and cross-functional execution — all central themes in your systems and operations work.
jobs.gap: You will need to translate healthcare and marketing examples into industry-neutral operations outcomes and show measurable project ownership.

jobs.title: Manager of Operations
jobs.why: Strong healthcare-operations match involving service delivery, multi-site operations, staffing, workflow execution and operational performance across the NY metro area.
jobs.gap: The role may favor candidates with longer formal healthcare-management tenure and direct multi-site leadership, so this is a strong but slightly more senior target.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager, RCM
jobs.why: Healthcare plus strategy and operations is well aligned with your goal, and your workflow, systems, process-improvement and cross-functional background gives you a credible story.
jobs.gap: Revenue-cycle-management specialization is the main gap; position your Medicaid, authorization, intake and healthcare workflow experience carefully without overstating RCM expertise.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager, Growth Marketing
jobs.why: Good fit for growth enablement, CRM/process operations, reporting, automation and your prior marketing background without requiring SEO to be the main job.
jobs.gap: Likely requires deeper dedicated marketing-operations and MarTech platform experience than your resume currently shows, so treat this as a growth-oriented reach.
